Lesson and question guide

36 questions adapted from your nine teaching PDFs. Page numbers count PDF pages from 1, including title pages.

Choose a short show (6 questions), standard show (18), full show (36), or one topic (6). Short and standard shows draw a mix from every topic. The same question is not repeated within a show.

All questions use simple prompts, hints and explanations. Learners can use Read to me, and there is no timer. Question stars and wheel bonus stars are reported separately. A correct answer after a hint or second try is recorded as “Correct with help”.

For practical work, use teacher supervision and follow the equipment instructions. A game score does not assess practical competence. Some practical methods are shown only in images or video in the PDFs; the game does not invent those missing steps.

Original game inspired by TV game shows. Not affiliated with The Price Is Right. Music and answer tones are original synthesised audio; there is no applause sound.

Stars and the virtual shop

Every correct answer adds one saved star. The final wheel adds 1–3 stars when its spin ends. Learners can open My shop during a show and return to their question. Revisiting a question or results does not award the same stars again.

The shop starts with a free rack and till. Items cost 1–8 stars. A confirmation shows “You have − Cost = Stars left”. The room and items have a sticker-book style. Choose an owned sticker, then tap anywhere in the shop. Drag placed stickers to move them, or use the arrow buttons and Place here. Stickers can overlap. Moving or putting away an item is free. Put-away items stay in My items. Older six-spot shops update automatically, keeping the saved stars and items. Bought wall and floor colours can be reused.

Stars, purchases, colours, layout and the shop name save in the current browser. One browser profile shares one shop. Students on separate iPads have separate shops. There is no cloud sync; clearing website data or using private browsing can remove progress. If saving is unavailable, the shop works for the current visit and says so.

Link students’ iPads

Open the student game. The owner has approved access without signing in.

Open Safari. Tap Share → Add to Home Screen → Add. Use the same browser or shortcut each time to keep the saved shop. An internet connection is needed to load the game.
